• Kathy
or
• the suppliers.

Dyeing Kits enterprise:
• ensuring fast delivery
• dealing with customer complaints
• developing new products.

project.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Enterprises can be affected by many factors. These include:
• changes in technology
• limited finance
• rules and regulations
• the needs or wants for the product.
Evaluate the importance of two factors to the success or failure of your enterprise project.
You may refer to the factors listed above or other factors in your answer.
